facts: The prison opened in 1796; granite string courses, ashlar limestone walls, square-headed sash openings with bars, and east and west additions define the entrance court.
Original rectangular enclosure with corner bastions extended to the east and north. Gates have elliptical heads, dressed stone facing the exterior and brick toward the yard.
The enclosure walls range from 30 to 50 feet. The late-1850s east wing replaced the original.
New Victorian east wing built three floors over basement with a broad radial terminus and a gallery bathed in light. The historic gate is set in the original range.
